Name: INCEpTION
Description: INCEpTION is a web-based platform for multi-layer linguistic annotation (e.g. PoS, dependencies, multiword expressions, coreference) with freely configurable layers and tagsets, entity linking against knowledge bases, and annotation suggestions that improve as you annotate. Its TSV support is WebAnno TSV, and its XML support covers TEI, TCF and UIMA XMI. It is the successor of WebAnno and can import WebAnno projects.
